subject.title: [Bug]: Generic Telegram failure suggests /new for non-user-recoverable model/config errors

question: Should this issue cover only the existing shared error-classification bug, or also introduce automatic sanitized administrator notifications for channel failures?
rationale: The misleading recovery copy is a narrow existing-contract bug, while choosing administrator recipients, routing, diagnostic content, and recovery UI adds a new cross-surface product policy.

options.title: Fix Classification Only
options.body: Land the narrow shared-core classification and actionable user copy, then track administrator notification and recovery UI separately.

options.title: Design Notifications Here
options.body: Keep the issue broad and require an explicit administrator-recipient, sanitization, delivery, and recovery contract before implementation.

recommendation.title: Fix Classification Only
recommendation.body: Land the narrow shared-core classification and actionable user copy, then track administrator notification and recovery UI separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-routing and shared failure-mapper history makes this the best available owner for the scope choice.
